scope: Read-only archive and mathematical review; no incoming code executed; Lean paused.
comparison_method: Exact bytes, not filename similarity. Existing files exclude this review directory. Prior incoming matches exclude the six archives under review.
static_check_method: Reviewer-authored inert-data parsing only: exact integer convolution of every paired equation.json residual/expanded polynomial found; topological and backward-live census for the supported list-node DAG schema; gzip/raw hash, byte length, bit length for resolved payload bindings. No incoming code imported, compiled, or executed. Claimed exact norm-circuit degrees and universal/calibration theorems are not certified by these checks.
matched_archives_scope: All six complete archives are distinct by SHA-256. Embedded ZIP equality is recorded by complete_incoming_archive_matches in content_matches_by_sha256. A shared inherited member does not make the entire new delivery an already reviewed archive.
